title: rosa gallica var. subinermis
intro: Rosa gallica var. subinermis, commonly known as the French rose or Apothecary's rose, is a fragrant, climbing rose plant native to southern Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The health benefits of Rosa gallica var. subinermis include its antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects.
